title: Multiplayer, Replay, Persistence, Recovery & Version Continuity

selection_basis.strict_order: GPR-01 → GPR-03 → GPR-05 → GPR-06 → GPR-07 → GPR-08 → GPR-09 → GPR-10 → GPR-12 → GPR-16
selection_basis.parallel_lanes: MRCS and OARC are terminal completed_verified; GPR is the only nonterminal persistent implementation lane.

objective: Implement gameplay-instance multiplayer/controller-slot authority, synchronization gates, deterministic replay/Event traces where declared, versioned snapshots, restore/migration, reconnect, unsupported-version/corruption behavior and bounded recovery while preserving owner-domain idempotency/version/recovery authority for owner mutations.
acceptance: Player/controller-slot authority and multiplayer synchronization are explicit; ambiguous or unsupported authority states fail closed.
Replay/Event traces are deterministic where the selected pattern declares replay support and preserve semantic command/outcome identity.
Snapshots are versioned, restoreable and identity-safe; snapshot data does not become reusable source truth or owner-domain canon.
Migration is explicit between supported versions and unsupported-version or corrupted state fails closed with bounded diagnostics.
Reconnect and recovery preserve gameplay-instance continuity without inventing owner-domain mutation receipts or bypassing owner idempotency/version rules.
Replay, snapshot, export and recovery surfaces preserve visibility/permission filtering and do not expose hidden participants, targets or state.
boundaries: GPR-01 through GPR-10 remain predecessors and are not duplicated.
GPR-12 owns gameplay-instance continuity only; owner-domain idempotency, versioning and recovery semantics remain authoritative for owner mutations.
Generic Packet-07 recovery semantics and PCA/Packet-08 simulation/formal-analysis authority remain external and are consumed rather than reimplemented.
Snapshots and replay traces are runtime evidence/state, not canonical content definitions or resource truth.
No mandatory paid/cloud service, 3D renderer or twitch-only input path may be introduced.
GPR-16 final conformance/golden proof/downstream handoff remains unauthorized until GPR-12 completes.
next_action: On a GPR-specific owner Continue, fresh-read GPR-12, GPR-10 publication evidence, owner-domain idempotency/version/recovery seams, Packet-07/Packet-08 boundaries, the GPR family design closure and ops3-lane-state/gpr, then execute the complete bounded continuity tranche.
